summary_en: This study tests ODM-212 in people with selected advanced solid tumours. ODM-212 is given as 5 mg and/or 40 mg tablets, and how long or how often it is taken is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1/2 first-in-human study with a dose escalation part and a dose expansion part.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ODM-212 en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados seleccionados. ODM-212 se administra en tabletas de 5 mg y/o 40 mg, y no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se toma. El resultado principal no se indica; se trata de un estudio de Fase 1/2 en seres humanos por primera vez, con una parte de escalado de dosis y una parte de expansión de dosis.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumour not amenable to curative treatment
Needs systemic cancer treatment and is refractory, progressed, intolerant, or not a candidate for established therapies
Part 2: measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (modified RECIST for mesothelioma) and an available tumour tissue sample
not_for: Brain or subdural metastases, unless asymptomatic and not needing treatment or adequately treated
Other malignancy active within the previous 2 years, with listed exceptions
Kidney impairment, end-stage renal disease, or urine albumin/creatinine ratio of 3 mg/mmol or higher
Significant heart disease, including heart failure, recent arrhythmia needing treatment, or LVEF below 50%
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or prior treatment with other TEAD inhibitors
